evidence.quote: Standard period of study 7 terms (incl. internship term), 210 ECTS
In the first semesters, modules are taught in English.
The fees for international students from non-EU countries amount to €1,500 per semester.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR

notes: Tuition is charged per semester; no annual figure is stated. The winter-semester deadline year 2026 is stated on the DAAD page; the summer deadline year is not stated on any page. The programme is an English-taught (B2) bachelor, so the German B2 requirement found on the international-applicants page (applying to German-taught programmes) is not listed. The requirement to obtain a VPD before applying is stated for applicants with a foreign qualification; the application itself is submitted in the university's own portal.

evidence.quote: Official proof of English language proficiency at level B2
IELTS – International English Language Testing System (Minimum overall score – 5.5)
TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language (iBT) (Minimum overall score – 72 / new scoring 2026: minimum overall score 4)

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux doivent faire évaluer leurs diplômes (VPD d'uni-assist, APS ou ZAB) et postuler dans les délais.
note.en: International applicants must have their certificates assessed (uni-assist VPD, APS or ZAB) and apply within the deadlines.

evidence.quote: International applicants require a certificate assessment (APS certificate, VPD from uniassist or evaluation of the ZAB ).
